review.notes: All OCR lines compared against extracted text of all 26 physical pages; physical pages 1 and 24 rendered and inspected at 300 dpi crops (website line and Appendix C batch-composition formulas). Code fences are balanced; the single fenced block is the printed Algorithm 1 pseudocode and its content matches the source. All section/appendix headings are printed headings in the PDF. The stray spacing 'p \in^3' on p.24 is printed by the PDF itself (verified on the render), so it was kept. 'action chunk [7]' on p.4 is a genuine citation in the source. No dropped paragraphs, footnote bodies, table rows or reference entries were found; only four localized OCR garbles were confirmed.
